fields.Field Name (Local ES): Entidad informante

fields.Field Name (Local ES): NIT del informante
fields.Format: N
fields.Field Explanation: NIT of the reporting employer. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 keys the DEADLINE to it: the LAST digit for a Gran Taxpayer, the LAST TWO digits for a legal or natural person. This is a third deadline rule, different again from Form 350 (last digit, 7th-16th business day) and PILA (last two digits, 2nd-16th business day).

fields.Format: Code
fields.Field Explanation: Gran Taxpayer, persona legal entity or equivalent, or natural person y asimilada.
